Conclusion:

The test `test_Host_header_overwrite` checks whether the custom host header is correctly appended to the request when using the `--print=hH` option. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Upon reviewing the code snippet of the failing test method, we observe that the expected behavior (correct appending of the host header) is being asserted incorrectly. The issue lies in the assertion statement on line 17. Instead of asserting that the host header appears exactly once (`r.lower().count('host:') == 1`), it should be checking if the host header is present at all (`'host:' in r.lower()`). This incorrect assertion leads to the test failure.
